description: Run a program with secrets from SEAL links or your inbox in its environment. The values never enter this conversation: they are removed from the output you get back. Use it instead of reading a secret file. With no secrets the program runs under this machine's guard: the keys it holds are put in only at their hosts.

command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell.

cwd.description: Working directory of the program; default this server's.

secrets.description: Each one is a link or an inbox item carrying one text file (up to 64 KiB), put into one variable of the program's environment. An empty list runs the program under this machine's guard alone: its proxy, its roots and the surrogates of the keys it holds in the program's environment (`run_no_guard` without a running guard).

item.description: An inbox handle from seal_inbox (`in_…`), instead of a URL.

name.description: The variable; default: the file's name in capitals (`Brave API key` → `BRAVE_API_KEY`).

url.description: Full SEAL share URL: its fragment is the key, or there is none on a link sent to this server's address.

timeout.description: Seconds; after them the program is killed.

name: seal_run
title: Run a program with secrets
